evals.prompt: Commit and push my changes in /tmp/eval-ship-1-ws. It's a pnpm TypeScript project and I'm already on feat/parser-add-csv-reader. I added a CSV reader and a test for it. The repo's .claude/settings.json sets includeCoAuthoredBy to false.
evals.expected_output: Agent sees it is already on a feature branch and does not create a new one. Detects pnpm from pnpm-lock.yaml, runs 'pnpm run format' and 'pnpm run lint:fix', verifies with the repo's own scripts, shows git status and the staged file list, reads settings.json to decide attribution and, since includeCoAuthoredBy is false there, commits with a conventional subject such as 'feat(parser): add CSV reader' and no Co-Authored-By trailer, asks before pushing, and pushes only after the user agrees. Does not open a PR.
expectations: Agent checks the current branch and confirms it is not main/master before committing
Agent does NOT create a new branch because the repo is already on a feature branch
Agent does NOT create a git worktree
Agent detects pnpm as the package manager, referencing pnpm-lock.yaml or the packageManager field
Agent runs the repo's own format and lint fix scripts via pnpm rather than ad-hoc commands
Agent shows git status and the staged file list before committing
Agent uses a conventional commit subject under 72 characters
Agent reads settings.json for attribution and omits the Co-Authored-By trailer because includeCoAuthoredBy is false; no Claude session link or model name appears
Agent asks for confirmation before pushing rather than pushing automatically
Agent does NOT open a pull request, since the user did not ask for one

evals.prompt: I finished the retry logic in /tmp/eval-ship-2-ws. Please commit it.
evals.expected_output: The repo is sitting on main. Agent refuses to commit on main, creates a branch named per Conventional Commits such as feat/client-add-retry-logic, works directly in the folder without a worktree, then formats, lint-fixes, verifies, stages with .claude/ and docs/plans/ excluded, and commits. Does not push and does not open a PR because neither was asked for.
expectations: Agent detects that the current branch is main and refuses to commit on it
Agent creates a new branch before committing, named <type>/<scope>-<description>
Agent does NOT create a git worktree and works in the existing folder
Agent runs the repo's package.json scripts for format and lint fix
Agent excludes .claude/, docs/plans/ and .plans/ from the staged files
Agent commits with a conventional commit message on the new branch
Agent does NOT push, since the user asked only for a commit
Agent does NOT open a pull request

evals.prompt: Commit and push my work in /tmp/eval-ship-3-ws. Heads up, the pre-commit hook has been strict lately.
evals.expected_output: Agent branches if needed, formats, lint-fixes, stages and commits. The pre-commit hook fails on a type error in src/client.ts. Agent reads the hook output, fixes the actual type error rather than suppressing it, re-stages, and retries. The second attempt succeeds. Agent asks before pushing, then pushes, and reports what was root-caused.
expectations: Agent attempts a commit that fails on the pre-commit hook
Agent does NOT use --no-verify and does not disable or delete the hook
Agent reads the hook output and fixes the root cause in the file the hook named
Agent does NOT suppress the error with a cast, an ignore comment, or a weakened test
Agent re-stages the fixed files and retries the commit
Agent stays within 3 commit attempts
Agent asks for confirmation before pushing
Agent reports which hook failure was fixed and how

evals.prompt: Commit, push and open a PR for /tmp/eval-ship-4-ws. The change adds token refresh to the auth package.
evals.expected_output: Agent branches if on main, runs format, lint:fix and verification, stages cleanly, commits with a conventional message, asks separately before pushing and again before opening the PR, then opens a draft PR whose title is a Conventional Commit subject and whose body contains only Summary, Trade-offs and Follow-ups. No test plan section, no chat narrative, no security commentary, no release-type opinion.
expectations: Agent asks for confirmation before pushing and again, separately, before opening the PR
PR is opened as a draft
PR title is a Conventional Commit subject, for example feat(auth): add token refresh
PR body contains a Summary section, a Trade-offs section and a Follow-ups section
PR body contains NO '## Test Plan' section
PR body contains no chat narrative, security-review commentary, or release-type or version-bump opinion
PR body contains no Claude session link, model name or other AI identifier
Agent reports the PR URL and that it is a draft

evals.prompt: Commit all unstaged changes in /tmp/eval-ship-5-ws. Ignore "notes.local.md".
evals.expected_output: Agent branches first if on main, then stages everything except notes.local.md, and also excludes .claude/, docs/plans/ and .plans/. It shows the staged file list so the exclusions are visible, then commits with a conventional message. notes.local.md remains modified but unstaged afterwards. No push and no PR.
expectations: Agent excludes notes.local.md from staging as the user requested
Agent also excludes .claude/, docs/plans/ and .plans/ without being asked
Agent shows the staged file list before committing so exclusions are visible
The commit does not contain notes.local.md
Agent uses a conventional commit message
Agent does NOT push and does NOT open a pull request
